name: Pia♥Carrot e Youkoso!! 2.2
original_name: Pia♥キャロットへようこそ!!2.2
source:
2.2 begins where Pia Carrot 2 ends, but protagonist can not find himself a girlfriend. Through December and January he will have another chance with a new set of girls. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《歡迎來到Pia Carrot!!2.2》的故事緊接《歡迎來到Pia Carrot!!2》結局展開，但主角仍未找到女朋友。從十二月到隔年一月，他將認識一群女孩，再度迎來談戀愛的機會。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
